title: The Gilded Groves
description: One of the Aether: Redux's new biomes is the Gilded Groves, a golden forest littered with flowers and Golden Clovers.

title: The Frosted Forests (and the Glacial Taiga)
description: The Aether: Redux also adds another new biome, the Frosted Forests, a chilling biome covered in snow, and an abundance of Icestone. It also has a variant seen in this image, the Glacial Taiga, which has more purple trees, which are also a bit more sparse.

title: Cloudcaps
description: One of the more alien biomes in the mod, the Cloudcaps are a mushroom-filled forest, where you'll find the new Shimmercow mob, along with the little snail-like Mykapod.

title: The Blight
description: The Aether: Redux also adds a more dangerous new biome, The Blight, which is filled with Cockatrices and the new Blightbunny.

title: Skyfields
description: On the less dangerous side of things, the mod also adds a nice new biome known as the Skyfields. This biome has a lot of color, notably the pretty Iridia flowers and the prismatic Fieldsproot tree.

title: Skyroot Shrublands
description: Another new biome added is the Skyroot Shrublands, a landscape filled with dense bushes (and the occasional tree), along with some flowers and Coarse Aether Dirt.
